name: Horn of Mead
desc: Golden honey-mead in a drinking horn, the drink poured on Valhalla's benches.

name: Swan Feather
desc: A white feather from a valkyrie's swan-cloak. Cold to the touch, and it never quite settles when laid down.

name: Oath Ring
desc: A heavy silver arm-ring of the kind oaths are sworn on. It seems to grow heavier when someone nearby is lying.

name: Golden Bristle
desc: A bristle from Gullinbursti, the boar the dwarfs forged. It glows bright enough to read by.

name: Djed Amulet
desc: A little blue faience pillar, the sign of stability on Ptah's own staff. It always stands upright.

name: Tanuki Leaf
desc: A shining gold coin, until you look at it twice. Then it's a big green leaf with a bite out of it.

name: Mistletoe Sprig
desc: Too young to swear an oath, they said. It is sharper than it looks.

name: Banshee's Comb
desc: A silver comb, given freely by its owner. Never pick one up that you find lying on the road.

name: Fairy Shoe
desc: A single shoe no longer than your thumb, stitched finer than any mortal could. Never a pair.

name: Oberon's Cup
desc: A little goblet from the fairy king's own hand. It brims with wine for an honest man and stays dry for a liar.
